coordinateConvention: Zero-based absolute source pixels. Geometric height=bottomY-topY; inclusive occupancy adds the endpoint pixel. Adaptive sourceRegion records complete parcels crossing nominal 418px cuts. Source pixels unchanged.

visibleOpening.note: Actual personnel entrance; both selected same-x dark opening endpoints are visible. Outer architectural trim is excluded.

groundPlaneEstimate.method: Robust alpha>128 foreground bottom-contour fits with 95th-percentile positive residual locating post feet below raised rails. Visually checked against lower post tips / stone-wall base. Side corners are projected physical foot-line estimates, not global silhouette extrema; ±3px painted/post-width uncertainty. Opposite side midpoint defines ground datum; hidden back vertex is unobserved.

groundAlphaInspection.note: Visual source inspection shows transparent ground holes between architecture, paths, shrubs and the fence. Alpha samples are confined to the physical foreground triangle.
